Monday, September 14 at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT

nary_nodes.label: Emmy Nominees Unveiled
evidence: The nominees for the 78th Annual Primetime Emmy Awards were unveiled Wednesday, with Hollywood honoring a slew of new shows and setting up what’s expected to be a battle among two legends in the race for outstanding lead actress in a comedy series.

nary_nodes.label: Expected Lead Actress Battle
evidence: The nominees for the 78th Annual Primetime Emmy Awards were unveiled Wednesday, with Hollywood honoring a slew of new shows and setting up what’s expected to be a battle among two legends in the race for outstanding lead actress in a comedy series.

In the comedy categories, fans in the lead actress category seem set for a full civil war, with the likely frontrunners being Lisa Kudrow for “The Comeback” and Jean Smart for “Hacks,” both of whom gave stellar turns in the final seasons of their respective series.

nary_nodes.label: Apple TV was a big winner
evidence: Apple TV was one of Wednesday’s big winners, with its new series “Pluribus,” “Margo’s Got Money Troubles,” and “Widow’s Bay” all making strong showings.

nary_nodes.label: The Pitt dominated drama categories
evidence: But Emmys voters also continued to honor returning favorites like “The Pitt,” which again dominated the drama categories.

nary_nodes.label: The Pitt notched 25 nominations
evidence: The HBO Max medical drama notched 25 nominations, the most of any show.

nary_nodes.label: Euphoria snubbed in top category
evidence: Elsewhere in the drama categories, “Euphoria” was snubbed in the top category after a divisive final season, but still earned acting nods for Zendaya and Colman Domingo.

nary_nodes.label: Zendaya and Colman Domingo nominated
evidence: Elsewhere in the drama categories, “Euphoria” was snubbed in the top category after a divisive final season, but still earned acting nods for Zendaya and Colman Domingo.

nary_nodes.label: Heated Rivalry ineligible for Emmys
evidence: The gay hockey drama wasn’t eligible for Emmys because it’s an entirely Canadian production.

nary_nodes.label: Connor Storrie got Emmy nod
evidence: But co-lead Connor Storrie got an Emmy nod anyway for his guest appearance on “Saturday Night Live.”

nary_nodes.label: Lisa Kudrow's stellar performance
evidence: Lisa Kudrow for “The Comeback” and Jean Smart for “Hacks,” both of whom gave stellar turns in the final seasons of their respective series.

nary_nodes.label: Jean Smart won four Emmys
evidence: Smart has already won four Emmys for her role as Deborah Vance in the HBO comedy

nary_nodes.label: Lisa Kudrow won one Emmy
evidence: Kudrow has won just once in 1998 in the supporting category for her iconic role as Phoebe Buffay in “Friends.”

nary_nodes.label: Widow's Bay strong showing
evidence: The other big headline in the outstanding comedy category? The strong showing from “Widow’s Bay,” which earned 19 nominations.

nary_nodes.label: Widow's Bay earned 19 nominations
evidence: The strong showing from “Widow’s Bay,” which earned 19 nominations.

nary_nodes.label: Widow's Bay huge word-of-mouth hit
evidence: The horror-comedy, which stars Matthew Rhys as mayor of an island experiencing supernatural phenomena, has been a huge word-of-mouth hit for Apple TV.

nary_nodes.label: The Bear earned nomination
evidence: “The Bear” still managed to earn a nomination for outstanding comedy series.

nary_nodes.label: Ayo Edebiri and Rob Reiner nominated
evidence: But while Ayo Edebiri and late Hollywood legend Rob Reiner received nominations for their work on the show

nary_nodes.label: Jeremy Allen White snubbed
evidence: star Jeremy Allen White was snubbed despite previously winning his category twice.

nary_nodes.label: Matthew Rhys scored nomination
evidence: Wednesday was a particularly good day for Rhys, who also scored a nomination in the limited series category for his turn as a menacing billionaire in “The Beast in Me”

nary_nodes.label: Claire Danes picked up nod
evidence: opposite costar Claire Danes, who similarly picked up a nod.

nary_nodes.label: Keri Russell honored for role
evidence: Rhys’ partner, Keri Russell of “The Diplomat,” was also honored for her role as a steely US ambassador on that Netflix drama.

nary_nodes.label: Emmy Awards Ceremony Broadcast
evidence: The Emmy Awards will be hosted by “Law & Order: Special Victims Unit” star Mariska Hargitay and will air live on Monday, September 14 at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT on NBC, streaming on Peacock.
